description: Server + client support! – Fabric 0.16.10 Sneak and mine one ore block to break the whole vein. Supports Fortune, Silk Touch, and all standard ores including deepslate, nether, and ancient debris. No config, no keybinds — just sneak, swing, and mine smarter.

mods.name: Vein Miner
mods.description: Mines connected ores when sneaking with a pickaxe
